summary: Frozen A2 has no existing boss-to-Zone-2 competence. Across 72 held-out Zone 1 boss starts and three policy modes it produced zero Zone 2 entries with zero controller restarts. Deterministic A2 timed out on all 24 seeds, dealt no damage, and killed no enemies. The two stochastic streams killed only 8 and 4 enemies, died on 8 and 7 seeds, and timed out on the remaining 33 episodes. This rejects early-floor navigation as the only blocker and identifies boss tactics as an independent learning problem. Proceed to the predeclared EXP-0014 short-horizon boss curriculum; no curriculum-start evidence is eligible for normal-start promotion.
